instructions: Select by business content, not file extension. Use generic when unsure.
Submit extracted Markdown separately from analysis. Never add inferred statements to source Markdown.
For every populated field or point cite an exact quote and character offsets in the submitted Markdown. Use basis=explicit or inference.
Unknown fields must be null. Do not invent names, amounts, dates or confidence scores.
Additional sections can use other templates in separate submissions. Original files and confirmed business fields are not modified.
Citation offsets count Unicode code points: use Python slices or JavaScript Array.from(markdown), not UTF-8 byte positions or UTF-16 string indexes.

Write a useful overview rather than a source excerpt: open with the central purpose or conclusion, then organize distinct key points in descending importance. Each point should explain the fact together with its conditions or implications. Avoid repeating the same fact across points.

Cover the material information present in the document: responsibilities, scope, constraints, exceptions, decisions, next actions and unresolved issues as applicable. Usually provide 3–7 focused points when the source supports them; short sources may need fewer. Never pad content or invent missing details to reach a count.

The summary is the default user view. Include important populated template fields and additional findings in the summary when material; do not hide essential conclusions only in fields. Use plain bullet text, not number cards or repeated agent/source labels. Cite evidence separately.

Before submission, compare the overview with the complete extracted Markdown: preserve qualifications, distinguish explicit facts from inference, remove generic filler and duplicate quotations, and check that important sections were not omitted. A longer overview is not automatically a better one.

Optionally submit tags: up to 20 concise content-based names, reusing the space catalog when appropriate. Prefer subjects, purpose and project themes; avoid names, account numbers and incidental amounts. Do not copy platform format labels unless useful. Omit/null to use platform fallback rules; [] explicitly chooses no automatic labels. Manual user tag edits take precedence.
